reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: The upgrade notes list the metric under Changed Metrics: it is now exposed as envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout instead of envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout, so monitoring that queries the old name needs to be checked.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and recording rules to use envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout.

proposed.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout`, so monitoring that queries the old name needs to be checked.
